packet.title: Optional features and the size budget (design, build)

body.p: After the owner's size decision ( Proposed).

item.p: Specifications: none. This is an engineering mechanism.

Owns: include/sxml/processor.h (option 2: sxml_optional_feature, sxml_optional_feature_view as the last field of sxml_processor_configuration, and the record), new src/optional_feature.c and src/optional_feature_internal.h, bindings/javascript/ (module variants, the feature list in the API, the budgets in CMakeLists.txt), and the CLI's and drivers' processor setup (single hunks).
Header change: under option 2, an additive change to processor.h; under option 3, none (CMake options and stub files); under option 4, new resource kinds, added by the packets that need them.

Mechanism: a feature's operations table is static const. The core finds it by kind in the processor (no global state) and never calls one feature from another (). The place of each feature becomes "this feature is not configured".

Done when: the mechanism exists, with one feature-free test feature; the size test checks both modules; and the size of sxml.wasm is measured before and after (it must not grow). Done 2026-10-19 (): sxml.wasm 2,003,575 to 2,004,485 bytes (the mechanism's own 910 bytes; no feature in the core), sxml-full.wasm 2,005,513; budgets 2,100,000 and 3,000,000.
